a: VLBI observing time on the EVN, optionally with joint e-MERLIN and global VLBI on NRAO/GBO telescopes, plus MeerKAT and GMRT at L-band. From 2027 the EVN observes in 10 one-week sessions a year. JIVE offers user support.
dt: Last deadline 1 Oct 2026, 16:00 UTC. From 2027 the EVN moves to two calls a year with deadlines on 1 April and 1 October, so the next regular deadline is 1 April 2027. ToO and short requests may be sent at any time.
e: Open call from an international VLBI consortium. 'The EVN facility is open to all astronomers', except that PIs and co-Is at institutes in Russia or Belarus are currently barred. Student proposals are encouraged.
n: European VLBI Network (EVN) Call for Proposals, 1 April 2027 deadline
unv: The April 2027 call document is not yet released; the date comes from the stated new fixed schedule.
